name: speechrewinder-for-youtube
description: Chrome extension that overlays a rewind-to-just-before-the-next-utterance HUD on YouTube. Originally built for competitive karuta (上の句直前への巻き戻し) but useful for any pinpoint re-listening.

scripts.package: npm run build && find dist -name .DS_Store -delete && rm -rf dist/.vite && rm -f speechrewinder-for-youtube.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../speechrewinder-for-youtube.zip .
